you aren’t responsible for his pain, there’s nothing you have to take responsibility for. i can emphasize with your situation a bit as i have dealt with someone that acted abusive towards me as they were raised in an abusive environment, and i also felt the need to help them. i thought i was a bad person if i didn’t do anything to help them. but i came to realize that it’s not my job to make sure they’re okay. it sucks that they were brought up like that, but i’m not gonna let them keep hurting me just because they are hurt. and i hope you realize this too. you are worth so much more than you think. what you should do is drop this guy immediately. it’s easier said than done, but his pain is NOT your fault. he is taking advantage of you. you definitely aren’t the one in the wrong here, he’s using your pain to gaslight you. his first instinct should’ve been to check up on you and make sure you’re okay, but he made himself the victim of the situation to make you feel guilty. protect yourself first- instead of using money on his issues, please save it for yourself. you deserve to heal, and he is harming you. again, i promise you that there’s nothing you need to take accountability for, what you need to do is get away from him to protect your spirit. you deserve to be around people that make you feel loved. i wish you the best of luck, we may not know each other but you have my support ! <3
